Calculate spectral metrics

Source: R/calculate_spectral_metrics.R
calculate_spectral_metrics.Rd

Calculates CV, SV, and CHV for each area of interest (AOI) directly from multiband rasters, without first extracting every pixel into a data frame. Each raster is cropped and masked to each AOI polygon; CV and SV are calculated from per-band summary statistics (terra::global()), and CHV from the matrix of pixel values within the AOI.

Spectral variance (SV) is standardized by the number of spectral points, so it is not rarefied; rarefaction applies to CV and CHV only.

Usage

calculate_spectral_metrics(
  raster_files,
  aoi_files,
  wavelengths,
  aoi_id_col = NULL,
  masked = TRUE,
  rarefaction = FALSE,
  min_points = NULL,
  n = NULL,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

raster_files

Character vector of multiband raster file paths. The site name is taken from the start of each file name, up to the first _ or . (or the whole name, minus extension, if there is neither), so NSABHC0009_ortho.tif, NSABHC0009.ortho.tif and NSABHC0009.tif all give the site NSABHC0009.

aoi_files

Character vector of AOI file paths: shapefiles (.shp), GeoJSON (.geojson/.json) or GeoPackage (.gpkg), each containing one or more AOI polygons. Each raster is matched to the AOI file with the same site name, found the same way (e.g. NSABHC0009_aoi.shp). Files with other extensions (e.g. a shapefile's .dbf) are ignored. If an AOI's coordinate system differs from its raster's, the AOI is reprojected to match.

wavelengths

Character vector naming the wavelength of each raster layer, in layer order.

aoi_id_col

Optional character; name of a column in the AOI file to use as the aoi_id. When NULL (default), AOIs are numbered 1:n.

masked

Logical; labels the output image_type as "masked" or "unmasked". It does not mask the image.

rarefaction

Logical; if TRUE, CV and CHV are averaged over n random subsamples of min_points pixels per AOI, which standardizes uneven pixel numbers across AOIs and increases processing time.

min_points

Integer; pixels sampled per AOI when rarefaction = TRUE.

n

Integer; number of subsamples when rarefaction = TRUE.

seed

Integer or NULL; if provided, set.seed(seed) is called once at the start so the rarefaction sampling is reproducible.

Value

A data frame with one row per AOI per raster, and columns site, aoi_id, CV, SV, CHV and image_type.

Examples

aoi_files <- list.files(
  system.file("extdata/aoi", package = "saltbush"),
  pattern = "image_aoi\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE
)
raster_files <- list.files(
  system.file("extdata/multiband_image", package = "saltbush"),
  pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE
)
metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(
  raster_files, aoi_files,
  wavelengths = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),
  masked = FALSE
)
metrics
#>        site aoi_id        CV          SV          CHV image_type
#> 1 multiband      1 0.3355707 0.004328054 3.053635e-09   unmasked
#> 2 multiband      2 0.3642174 0.003440723 3.238245e-09   unmasked
#> 3 multiband      3 0.4671316 0.003904554 3.234787e-09   unmasked
#> 4 multiband      4 0.3758902 0.001296762 1.625732e-09   unmasked
